Contributing to supabaseR

Source: CONTRIBUTING.md

Thank you for your interest in contributing to supabaseR!

Getting Started

  1. Fork the repository
  2. Clone your fork locally
  3. Create a new branch following our branch naming conventions (see below)
  4. Make your changes and test them
  5. Commit using conventional commits (see below)
  6. Submit a Pull Request

Commit Convention

We use Conventional Commits for all commit messages.

Examples:

feat(db): add support for JSON columns
fix(query): resolve WHERE clause escaping issue
docs: update installation instructions

Branch Naming

Branch names follow the same convention as commits:

<type>/<short-description>

Examples: feat/add-storage-support, fix/connection-timeout, docs/update-readme

Development

# Install dependencies
install.packages("devtools")

# Load package
devtools::load_all()

# Run tests
devtools::test()

# Build documentation
devtools::document()

Guidelines

  • Keep things readable and follow existing conventions of code structure
  • Add roxygen2 documentation for all exported functions
  • Include tests for new features and ensure all tests pass before submitting
  • Update NEWS.md with your changes

Thank you for contributing!
